MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 75

2. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

8. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 64
   D. 32

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 32
   C. 16
   D. 55

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
